subject: [PATCH] mm: list_lru: don't use a new memcg's lists for an offline memcg

reviews.author: Andrew Morton
reviews.summary: Andrew Morton noted that the patch was merged into the mm-hotfixes-stable branch and therefore dropped from the -mm tree.

2026-11-22.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Linux kernel's memory cgroup (memcg) implementation where an offline memcg's lists are reused by a new memcg, leading to list corruption and crashes when THPs are freed. The fix involves recording the owning memcg in each list_lru_memcg and treating the index as empty if its lists belong to another memcg. This prevents concurrent changes to the parent's list from leaving pointers to freed folios.
